description: Reads exact product or variant details from Shop Nobi's public catalog. Supply one selector: id or variantId for a Nobi variant, productId for a Nobi parent product, sourceVariantId or sourceProductId for the store's own catalog ID, sku, or productUrl for an exact stored URL. Shopify product or variant IDs must be paired with the selling merchant: send storeDomain, such as example.com, or a known Nobi merchantId. Source IDs and SKUs are never resolved globally. Nobi IDs accept a UUID or the Base62 ID returned by search. Shopify source IDs accept numeric IDs or correctly typed Shopify GIDs. A parent selection returns parent information and variant choices, with id, variantId, price, currency, stock, inventory and variant specifications unset until a variant is selected. Ambiguous or conflicting selectors are refused. The tool never fetches a supplied URL. Catalogs contain no reviews or ratings. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

id.description: Legacy alias for variantId, returned as id by search.

merchantId.description: The store's Nobi merchant UUID, returned by search.

productId.description: Nobi parent product UUID or Base62 product ID; selects no variant.

productUrl.description: An exact HTTPS catalog product URL, optionally with its numeric Shopify variant selector. Never fetched.

sku.description: Literal exact SKU within one store. Duplicate matches are refused. Requires merchant context.

sourceProductId.description: The store's parent product ID, such as a Shopify numeric product ID or Product GID. Pair it with storeDomain (the selling merchant's hostname) or a known Nobi merchantId.

sourceVariantId.description: The store's variant ID, such as a Shopify numeric variant ID or ProductVariant GID. Pair it with storeDomain (the selling merchant's hostname) or a known Nobi merchantId.

storeDomain.description: The store's exact hostname, such as example.com, or its HTTPS address.

variantId.description: Nobi variant UUID or Base62 variant ID.

visitorId.description: For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

visitorId.description: For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.
